subject: [PATCH v6 05/12] mm: zswap: add range lookup for large-folio swapin

reviews.author: Usama Arif (author)
reviews.summary: Author agreed to restructure the swap_cache_add_check() path in v2 to check if a folio exists in zswap after __swap_cache_do_add_folio(), using the existing allocation rollback path.
reviews.raw_body:
Yes, I think the above makes sense. I am looking at the code and I think we
can check the range after __swap_cache_do_add_folio() and use
the existing allocation rollback path if the folio exists in zswap.

The code will look slightly different from the diff below, but will
achieve the same thing.

Thanks for the review!

2026-08-19.patch_summary: This patch adds range lookup support to the zswap compression algorithm, allowing it to handle large folio swapins by scanning the covered range and returning an error if any slot is still in zswap. It also introduces a new function `zswap_is_present` to check if a PMD swap-entry is present in zswap before attempting PMD-order swapin. The patch addresses issues with partial initialization of data when reconstructing large folios from compressed entries, and clarifies the error handling for conflicts between zswap and disk-backed swap.
